name: transition-craft
description: Six transitions with exact presets and the editing rules behind them: photo collage burst, Droste recursive zoom into a screen, impact tile-flip mosaic, bokeh light-spot transition, 3D photo cloud gallery and a camera-shake distort cut. Presets give the core length in frames, where the peak lands on the beat, log-space zooms, shake amplitude, frequency and decay, motion-blur shutter angle, bokeh sizes, tile counts and stagger, from Walter Murch, Dan Ebberts' decaying-sine expression, Boris FX, Maxon and Unreal camera-shake defaults, measured transition durations and editors on X. Use when a video needs a transition on the beat, an infinite zoom, a shake cut, a bokeh or photo-collage transition. NOT for plain crossfades and xfade wipes (varg-video-edit-library lists every ffmpeg xfade).
